purpose: Operating runway and breakeven model to support execution decisions
caveat: Illustrative planning model; not investment advice or committed financing.

phase_1_foundation_m1_m3.description: Production hardening, initial GTM motion, critical analyzer completion

phase_2_traction_m4_m8.description: Customer growth, enterprise readiness, reliability scaling

phase_3_scale_m9_m12.description: Enterprise closing motion, retention expansion, valuation readiness

conservative.notes: Requires tight cost control or additional financing before month 9.

moderate.breakevenMonth: M11-M12 (if costs do not exceed phase plan)
moderate.notes: Most plausible base-case if customer acquisition and retention stay near target.

aggressive.notes: Depends on faster enterprise conversion and lower churn than baseline.

runwayDecisionRules.rule: If projected cash-out date is within 6 months, freeze non-critical hiring and re-baseline costs within 7 days.
If MRR misses target by >20% for 2 consecutive months, trigger GTM strategy correction and scenario downgrade.
If retention drops below 90% for 2 consecutive months, halt expansion spend until root causes are corrected.
If enterprise deal cycle exceeds 120 days median without late-stage progression, de-risk plan by emphasizing SMB revenue path.
